_howto: Human-vetted advisories, shown as authoritative. Fields: title (required), lines (array of purple/green/yellow; omit or leave empty for network-wide), severity (info|warning|disruption), detail, url (source link), from/to (ISO datetimes). Omitting 'to' keeps an advisory active until you remove it — set it once service is restored. An advisory whose 'to' has passed still shows for 3 hours marked 'may be resolved', then disappears. Unverified machine-scanned reports live in signals.json (written by tools/fetch_news.mjs) and render as dashed 'Unconfirmed report' cards; promote one here after confirming via @OfficialBMRCL.
